questions.content:
For which of the following parameters the structural isomers C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>5</sub>OH and CH<sub>3</sub>OCH<sub>3</sub> would
be expected to have the same values? (Assume ideal behaviour)

options.content: Gaseous densities at the same temperature and pressure
Vapour pressure at the same temperature
